old_problem: Unlike BD2, the manifest contains no second logical I2C E1S_BD3 Source Identity. Treating this sole row as MANUAL ONLY based on reference inference could silently omit the BD3 management-sideband path. Conversely, choosing only a logical probe could miss connector and conductor defects. The external specification is required to define complete coverage.
disposition_reason: Retain Pending and BLOCKED. BD3 has one Source Identity, so Engineering must explicitly assign every required logical and physical/electrical stage to it. ED-09 makes any physical work human-only but does not authorize dropping logical I2C coverage. Board/slot/connector identity, route or pinout, acceptance and recovery remain core semantics.
decision_basis: The exact XLSX row 1813, same-row DeepSeek/test-json, GPT V2, historical record, pending/blocked analyses and ED-01 through ED-30 were read. The next formal locked-queue identity was directly opened as Functionality row 1814 / Wistron-HW-00013-V003 / 49dc9aab2d16a28c.
Manifest-wide history found no separate I2C E1S_BD3 row; this case must not lose any intended management-sideband coverage through a physical-only inference.
Logical I2C cannot prove every conductor/mechanical condition, and physical inspection/continuity cannot prove mux/address/firmware response.
ED-09 assigns physical work to humans; ED-03/ED-15 prohibit guessed logical topology and unapproved physical/electrical thresholds.
BD1/BD2 routes, pins and results cannot be copied because ED-19 preserves independent BD3 identity and coverage.
No I2C, BMC, E1.S, NVMe, physical, continuity, reset, retry or DUT action was performed.

test_case.purpose: Preserve all intended coverage in the sole BD3 case by separately validating every owner-required logical BMC/I2C and physical inspection/continuity checkpoint for the exact BD3 hardware.
required_package: E1S_BD3 vendor/platform specification and exact board/slot/cable/connector/endpoint identity
Complete coverage matrix explicitly listing required logical-I2C, visual/physical, continuity and any signal checkpoints
For logical stages: BMC/OOB controller/mux/bus/address/transaction and expected-response matrix
For physical/electrical stages: pinout, isolation/ESD state, qualified operator/instrument and numeric limits
E1.S/NVMe presence/health criteria, maintenance authorization, evidence plan and independent recovery
test_case.test_command: BLOCKED; perform no bus or physical action. After the complete BD3 contract receives fresh review, execute each approved stage separately: secure bounded BMC/OOB reads for logical coverage and qualified-human inspection/continuity or signal measurements in the specified safe state for physical/electrical coverage. Capture BD3-specific evidence with pre/post E1.S/NVMe, BMC SEL/SDR and OS health. Do not copy BD1/BD2, invent addresses/pins/limits, energize incomplete hardware, clear logs or automatically retry.
test_case.expected_result: No current executable PASS exists. Future PASS requires exact BD3 identity and every required stage independently meeting its endpoint-response, physical-condition, continuity and/or signal limits, with E1.S/NVMe presence, namespaces/storage health and platform management unchanged.
test_case.pass_fail_basis: Current result is BLOCKED. MANUAL ONLY, logical enumeration or a single evidence modality cannot PASS unless the owner explicitly defines it as complete. Missing stage/specification, copied topology, wrong endpoint/pin, response or measurement failure, damage, storage/management anomaly or incomplete evidence is FAIL/BLOCKED for owner verdict.
safety_gate: Do not assume physical continuity is the complete sole-BD3 requirement or omit the logical sideband without owner approval.
Do not copy BD1/BD2 topology or probe unknown BD3 pins, buses, addresses or control endpoints.
All physical work requires a qualified human and approved ESD/power isolation; logical work requires an exact allowlist.
Stop on damage, open/short, device disappearance, storage, BMC or bus anomaly; do not retry/reset automatically.
expected_evidence: Approved complete BD3 specification, hardware identity and coverage matrix
Logical controller/mux/address and raw-response evidence for every required management checkpoint
Human photos/inspection and continuity/signal measurements for every required physical checkpoint
Pre/post E1.S/NVMe presence/namespaces/health plus BMC SEL/SDR and OS evidence
Per-stage verdict, abort/no-retry/independent-recovery audit and owner disposition
test_case.recovery: No action is authorized now. Future recovery must be independent of BD3 and stage-specific. Stop and preserve evidence on any defect or health change without retry; connector work, bus/NVMe reset, reboot or power cycle requires separate explicit owner authorization.
